description:
Promote a staging-tested commit to PRODUCTION. Targets prod_slug='' (the primary
    `odoo`) or an extra instance's slug. SAFETY GATE: REFUSES unless the commit that
    `ref` was tested at on staging (recorded green) covers the requested modules -
    unless force=True. On confirm: (a) take a FRESH backup of prod first, (b) ensure the
    prod git dir + addons_path, (c) checkout the SAME commit, (d) `odoo -u <modules>
    --stop-after-init --workers=0 --no-http` (NO --test-enable on prod), (e) restart the
    service, (f) run acceptance/health checks. AUTO-ROLLBACK: if the upgrade fails, the
    service doesn't come back, or acceptance fails → restore the pre-promote backup,
    check out the PREVIOUS commit, restart, re-verify, and return rolled_back=True.
    dry_run (default) shows the plan + exact bash.
name: code_promote
